name: unrehearsed-2026-10-03-fresh
_note: SF-CMD-1 part (ii) completion census, written blind on Oct 3, 2026 by an author who never saw the corpus, the tests, the docs or the first blind file; 150 orders + 150 questions, each with its intended reading; never edited after the run.

intended.note: Ney at Rhineland strikes Mack at Swabia next door; a battle or an honest objection, nothing else.

orders.line: Marshal Ney, I want you to hit Mack at Swabia this morning

intended.note: Natural phrasing of the same attack; the place name confirms the target rather than becoming a march.
A march into the enemy-held province where Mack stands; the game should treat it as a move that will meet Mack, or refuse honestly, never silently redirect.

orders.line: soult dig in — the austrians are close

intended.note: Lowercase, no comma, an aside after a dash; Soult fortifies where he stands and the aside is not read as a target.

orders.line: Lannes and Murat, both of you move to Rhineland

intended.note: Two addressees; both Lannes and Murat should march from Franche-Comte to Rhineland, or the game asks which, never just one silently.

orders.line: Bernadotte, hold Franconia until Davout arrives

intended.note: A standing hold with an arrival condition on a friendly marshal; the echo should name the condition.

orders.line: Massena, stay where you are for two turns

intended.note: A timed hold of two turns at Milan.

orders.line: Murat, scout Swabia and tell me what Mack has

intended.note: A scout order with a reason clause; the tail is not a second order, and the report names the garrison/army if in range, else an honest range refusal.
The epithet resolves to Davout; taking an enemy province held by Mack means attacking him or marching there, not an unknown-marshal error.

orders.line: the Bravest of the Brave, go on, attack

intended.note: Epithet for Ney, no target named; the game picks the one foe in reach (Mack) or asks whom, never a different marshal.
A collective retreat for every marshal, or an honest refusal naming who cannot.

orders.line: all of you converge on Swabia

intended.note: A collective march toward Swabia, each marshal priced on his own road; not one marshal alone.
Pronoun with no earlier line; the game resolves to the only enemy in reach or asks who, and 'hunt down' is a pursuit.
A retreat with the particle 'now' ignored as filler.

orders.line: Soult, fortify Lorraine then drill your men

intended.note: Fortify first; the drill tail is either queued after it or reported as held, never executed instead of the head.

orders.line: Ney, attack Mack and then march to Munich

intended.note: The attack is the head; the march tail waits on the result and is reported, not fused into a bare move.

orders.line: Davout, move to Swabia; Ney, support him

intended.note: Two marshals, two orders split on the semicolon: Davout marches, Ney gets a support order on Davout.

orders.line: Massena, if Archduke Charles is still in Tyrol, attack him

intended.note: A conditional attack; if Charles is not seen in Tyrol the game says so and does nothing else.

orders.line: Lannes, when you get to Rhineland, dig in

intended.note: A march with a fortify on arrival as the tail.

orders.line: Bernadotte, march to Munich, but stop if Mack moves on Rhineland

intended.note: A march with a stop condition; the condition is echoed or honestly declared unsupported, never silently dropped.
A cavalry charge on Mack; Murat is not adjacent, so either a pursuit is offered or the range refusal says so.
Lowercase scout order.

orders.line: Davout, drill the troops this turn

intended.note: A drill at Rhineland, or an honest refusal if the enemy next door forbids it.
Soult forms square at Lorraine.

orders.line: Soult stop fortifying, we march tomorrow

intended.note: An unfortify; the reason clause is not read as a march order.
Lannes detaches a garrison into his own province.
An infantry levy at Paris; the game names who receives the men and the price.
A cavalry levy at Lyonnais, the arm respected or the refusal names why.

orders.line: I need artillery — recruit guns in Lorraine

intended.note: An artillery levy at Lorraine; if nobody there commands guns the refusal names the remedy.
A supply depot at Rhineland, priced.

orders.line: put up a fort in Lorraine

intended.note: A fort at Lorraine.
A market at Paris.
A repair at Rhineland, or an honest 'nothing damaged there'.

intended.note: A fortify at Franconia.

orders.line: Massena, unfortify and move to Piedmont

intended.note: Unfortify first, the move queued after.

orders.line: Murat, have a look at Swabia

intended.note: 'Have a look' is a scout.

intended.note: Two holds for two marshals; Soult's is the second clause.
